name: Lidl
note: German discount supermarket chain; majority owner of the Lidl-Trek team (Cyclingnews, 2025-12-11). The ownership chain (Lidl - Schwarz Group - Dieter Schwarz via a foundation) is state-free. ON HOLD for a maintainer: a major-NGO investigation reached Lidl inside the last 20 years - Oxfam's 'Ripe for Change / Workers Rights in Supermarket Supply Chains' research (Oxfam press release, 2019-10-09, oxfam.org/en/press-releases/human-rights-abuses-commonplace-farms-linked-major-european-supermarkets-oxfam-finds) documents poverty pay, gender discrimination and inadequate pesticide protection (workers reporting serious skin diseases) on Assam tea estates and North-East Brazil fruit farms supplying Lidl. Whether this supply-chain finding passes METHOD.md's company test is for a maintainer. Business & Human Rights Resource Centre also records a Lidl response re forced labour at Spanish strawberry suppliers (business-humanrights.org). Proposed tier if upheld: concern.
